Flow.description: Portal flow (Screen Flow: Individual Application Renewal). The License Renewal Form on the portal. The licensee ticks which of their own licenses or permits to renew and which need a duplicate, matching the paper form's two rows. Until they certify, nothing is written to Individual Application: the form keeps a draft (Preliminary Application Reference) that holds any documents uploaded, and can be saved for later and resumed from My Applications for 30 days. On certifying, each ticked license becomes a submitted Individual Application (Renewal record type; Application Type Renewal or Duplicate) with its fee: renewal fees come from Subflow: Fee Renewal Assessment, duplicate fees from the Fee Duplicate License rule (first free, one a year). The draft's documents move to the first renewal; the draft is deleted once payment is done. A reported name change sets the Name Change Proof Pending hold and requires proof. Ends with payment and the receipt. Runs in system context; it only ever uses the signed-in licensee's own licenses. Staff can also enter it for an applicant from New Application on the Person Account (input recordId); the pay step then tells them to record the payment.

formulas.description: A name change counts only when a renewal is chosen.

formulas.description: True when this license was ticked for renewal. The checkbox list returns the license names, so the name is matched; the Id is also accepted.

formulas.name: forB_DuplicateChosen

formulas.expression:
"

" & {!LoopThroughLicenses.Name} & ": " & BLANKVALUE({!varT_FeeProblem}, "the renewal fee could not be worked out.") & " The Board will contact you.

"

formulas.expression:
"

" & {!LoopThroughLicenses.Name} & ": a duplicate was issued in the last 12 months, and only one is allowed a year. Call the Board if you need help.

"

formulas.name: forT_TransferTarget
formulas.description: The draft's documents go to the first renewal, or the first application when only duplicates were asked for.

formulas.name: forDT_OpenHoldEnd
formulas.description: An open hold has no end date; 31 December 4000 stands for none.

formulas.name: forT_ProofApplicationIdOrNone
formulas.description: The name-change proof application, or a placeholder Id that matches nothing. The proof application's date is set by the checklist trigger once proof is in.

formulas.name: forT_DuplicateFeeName
formulas.description: Which Fee Schedule row prices this fee: the license type's name followed by Duplicate License, such as Cosmetologist Duplicate License.

formulas.name: forN_DuplicateAmount
formulas.description: The fee amount: the license type's row, or the generic Duplicate License row when the type has none.

formulas.name: forT_DuplicateFeeCode
formulas.description: The fee code from whichever Fee Schedule row priced the fee.
